EventBookings stranded-member review (2026-10-20)

Scope and judgments
The outer ZIP's MALICIOUS conviction is supplied by the queue and is retained.
It is not evidence that an individual JavaScript member is malicious.

component-bundle.js: BENIGN. A webpack UMD EventComponents client importing
jQuery. The application implements event cards, sessions, attendee forms,
checkout, coupon validation, maps, and payment UI. Order/coupon submissions go
to the configured EventBookings /v3/orders API with an x-api-key header. The
customer email near that header is an order field, not mail-service auth.
The analytics dispatcher reads configured track_type/tracking_id entries and
initializes Facebook, Google, GTM, or TikTok. It sends PageView, checkout, and
purchase events through their SDKs. The Facebook URL is reached by script
creation and fbq initialization, not by a Node package installation. Its UMD
require("jQuery") explains the uppercase package reference that was followed.
Internal Formeo, jQuery/UI, timezone, phone-input, and other UI implementations
explain most generic findings. The color regex table is a CSS parser. A
phone.charAt(0) lookup does not implement XOR. Function("return this") recovers
the global object. The embedded package.json's Prettier/lint-staged strings
are build metadata, not runtime shell execution. Long Base64/source-map and
SVG material are bundled assets, not an identified executable payload.
Source exceeds the analyzer's 2 MB flow budget, so conclusions use manual
control-flow/source inspection as well as symbol/literal facts. No claim of
complete automated value-flow coverage is made.

formeo.js: BENIGN. Formeo 1.6.2, exporting FormeoEditor and FormeoRenderer.
The module loader activates editor, field, drag/drop, renderer, localization,
and DOM utilities. Its resource helpers fetch text/SVG, load stylesheet/script
assets, and attach nodes to the page. Session/local storage caches form or
language state. Keyboard/mouse handlers drive interactive editing. UUID
formatting builds a 256-entry byte-to-hex table; this is not brute force.
"config.locked" is a dotted configuration lookup, not a renamed filename.
Global-object Function constructor fallbacks have constant bodies. Neither
obfuscated payload activation nor an unrelated collection-to-send path was
identified in the inspected modules.

pkg:npm/jQuery@1.7.4: BENIGN. Deprecated node-jquery distribution containing
the stock jQuery 1.7.2 browser implementation in a Node/jsdom wrapper, plus
build scripts and tests. SHA-1 f32dc5c85a7044ee864b4443b9ee45f9478ba137 and the
full supplied SHA-512 both match the downloaded tarball. The main export
creates jsdom, installs an XMLHttpRequest adapter, and exposes jQuery/noConflict
and create(). withCredentials=false configures the adapter prototype; it does
not replace an XHR method. Grunt build creates tmp/lib, fetches Google's jQuery
CDN over HTTP when the local source is missing, substitutes it into wrapper.js,
and writes lib/node-jquery.js. Grunt clean runs rm -rf on those build directories.
These are explicit developer tasks, not an install-hook payload. Stock AJAX,
JSONP, globalEval, and the validated JSON-parsing Function fallback are real
library capabilities. Sizzle's Dojo Foundation copyright does not identify the
artifact as Dojo. Test imports of nodeunit do not identify nodeunit's own code.
No invented deployment or trust-in-old-dependencies assumption is needed for
the benign judgment; the traced operations fit the shipped build/library role.

https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js: BENIGN. The fetched Meta Pixel
SDK registers SignalsFBEvents modules, resolves plugins/configuration, reads
pixel cookies and browser context, and sends event parameters through
sendBeacon, image/form, and other SDK transports. Default event destinations
include facebook.com/tr and instagram.com/tr. Identity matching normalizes
customer fields and applies an embedded SHA-256 implementation; form matching
explicitly excludes password inputs. flags.eval()/experiment.eval() are
feature-flag lookups, not JavaScript eval. The constant Function("return this")
fallback is real dynamic compilation and remains notable. The SDK's actual
input/telemetry and hashing capabilities are retained. Consent, deployment
configuration, and the bytes served by this mutable URL during the original
collection are unavailable: this judgment covers the downloaded snapshot.

Detection changes
- Require a literal .locked suffix instead of arbitrary dotted property keys.
- Remove charAt-only evidence from the XOR directory and reuse string lookup.
- Distinguish global JavaScript eval from ordinary object .eval methods.
- Recognize minified fetch(e), and hex/decimal spellings of SHA-256 constants.
- Scope bare formatter command text to shell/interpreter files.
- Tighten Dojo identity to its runtime version assignment and XHR method-hook
  evidence to method assignments, excluding prototype flags/equality checks.
- Require an email-service API-key field, not unrelated email/key proximity.
- Bind a byte mask to the charCodeAt result, not a later unrelated operation.
- Require server/environment context for a QUERY_STRING reference.
- Move script descriptors to DOM data; HTML plugin insertion to HTML operations;
  generic receiver-style URL paths to URL paths; and custom plugin function
  names to source metadata. Exact consumers were updated. A route shape proves
  neither a token's entropy nor an anonymous authenticated webhook.
- Retire the generic regex-row scanner identity and ESLint-config-name identity.
  Their former broad suppression membership is intentionally removed: ordinary
  CSS regex tables and dependency-name mentions establish no defensive context.
- Rename jQuery implementation markers that falsely asserted obfuscation.
- Move nodeunit require-call evidence into module loading; retain its explicit
  consumer in the testing-context composite.
- Add a precise Meta Pixel SDK module-registration identity.

Focused verification
Run: python3 testdata/eventbookings-member-review/verify.py
The cases exercise real operations, property/metadata near misses, equivalent
hash constants, plugin descriptors without build context, build hooks with
insertion context, and source function-name placement. Case files are scanned
under ordinary temporary paths so path-based fixture exclusions cannot hide
an unintended match. Source bytes are analyzed, never executed.

Fetched artifacts are saved beneath samples/1300c24015b0/dependencies for
stable local inspection and adjacent verdict markers. They are not Git inputs.
The two ZIP-member markers are beside the extracted files. The archive marker
is beside the original ZIP. All five were rescanned with atomscan in slow mode,
without refreshing rules or following further dependencies.
